title: Dark Effigy Guide — Chaos DoT Totem, Decoy and Damage Over Time
summary: Dark Effigy is a Totem skill: you plant a totem that continuously applies Chaos damage over time (Chaos DoT) to enemies in range. This guide explains how it acts as a 'decoy' so you don't have to stand in the damage, how its DoT scales with your chaos DoT multipliers, how it splits duties with Contagion / Essence Drain, totem count and duration limits, and why it is a great supplemental damage source for Lich chaos builds.
description: Dark Effigy deep guide: decoy totem mechanic, chaos DoT and multipliers, comparison with Contagion / Essence Drain, recommended duration / area / summon supports, ED + Contagion Lich role, totem-destroyed and DoT-gap causes with direct answers, video timestamps and real community questions.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial

sections.title: Overview: A Totem That Poisons For You
paragraphs: Dark Effigy is a Totem skill: you drop (or summon) a totem that continuously applies Chaos damage over time (Chaos DoT) to enemies in range. You yourself don't need to stand in the damage — the totem 'holds the line' for you, which is very comfortable in builds that like to keep distance or avoid facetanking.

Its damage form is damage over time (DoT), not burst. That means its power depends on your chaos DoT multiplier, damage-over-time modifiers and 'increased damage to affected enemies' style affixes, not crit or single hits. The gearing logic is completely different from a chaos hit build.

This is why it fits Lich / chaos builds: chaos DoT is already the core of those builds, and Dark Effigy, as a totem that doesn't consume your positioning and steadily applies DoT, lays your DoT multiplier 'one more layer' onto more targets — an excellent supplemental damage and sustained-pressure tool.
bullets: Essence: decoy totem, continuously applies chaos DoT to enemies in range.
You don't stand still; the totem outputs for you, easier at range.

Common partner: Lich / ED + Contagion chaos builds.

sections.title: Mechanics: How the Decoy Totem Outputs
paragraphs: Decoy output: once planted, the totem stays put and continuously applies chaos DoT to enemies in range. After planting you can reposition and cast other skills — the totem works independently. This is its biggest advantage over 'you yourself stand and cast a DoT skill': output doesn't consume your positioning.

DoT calculation: the chaos DoT the totem applies inherits your character's chaos DoT multiplier and damage-over-time modifiers. So when you stack 'damage over time', 'chaos damage', 'increased damage to affected / ailment enemies', the totem's per-second damage scales in sync. It doesn't drop out of your DoT system just because it's a totem.

Coverage and duration: the totem only works within a radius around itself and lasts a limited time. You must plant it on the pack's path or near the boss, and re-plant before expiry, or you get a 'totem gone, DoT gap' window.
bullets: Totem stands independently; after planting you reposition, output doesn't cost your positioning.
DoT inherits your chaos DoT multiplier and DoT modifiers, scales with gear.
Only works within its radius + limited duration; plant right and re-plant in time.

sections.title: Role in Builds
paragraphs: Supplemental layer in ED + Contagion Lich: the main system uses Essence Drain to apply DoT on single / small area and Contagion to spread for clear; Dark Effigy, as an independent totem, lays chaos DoT onto even more targets without consuming your cast positioning.

Pressure at range: the decoy totem lets you keep distance while still having steady DoT output — perfect for squishy Liches or players who dislike facetanking. Plant and you can dodge and reposition while damage never stops.

Synergy with ailments / curses: chaos DoT often stacks with 'increased damage to afflicted enemies' and curse affixes. Dark Effigy's steady DoT keeps those affix bonuses continuously fed, raising overall DoT efficiency.
bullets: ED + Contagion Lich: Effigy as independent filler totem, no positioning cost.
Squishy / range builds: plant and leave, DoT never stops.
Pairs with ailment / curse damage affixes, sustaining DoT efficiency.

sections.title: Common Mistakes: Totem Destroyed / DoT Gap
paragraphs: Totem keeps getting destroyed: the totem is an entity and gets cleared by monster attacks or AoE. Direct answer: plant it in a relatively safe spot (behind you, by cover) or use Increased Duration to reduce frequent re-plant exposure.

DoT gap: totem expires or you forget to re-plant, so the target's DoT vanishes. Direct answer: use Increased Duration to lengthen it and fold 're-plant totem' into your rotation — don't wait for the gap to remember.

Thinking it uses crit: Dark Effigy is DoT and doesn't scale off single-hit crit (unless you specifically stack DoT-relevant crit — butstandard DoT doesn't amplify via crit). Direct answer: invest in damage-over-time and chaos multiplier, not crit.
Planted wrong, no coverage: the totem only works within its radius; planted too far equals not planted. Direct answer: plant on the pack's path / near the boss so targets are inside the radius.
bullets: Direct answer: safe spot + Increased Duration, less exposure.
Direct answer: lengthen duration and fold re-plant into rotation.
